title: Silver Viz
concept: A journey through conflicting states of matter, transitioning from archival stillness to chaotic chemical reactions and ultimately to a vast, indifferent cosmic suspension.
style: No people, no figures, no buildings, no landscape, no horizon. No object with a visible outline — no vessel, bowl, panel or plate. The matter fills the frame edge to edge and continues past it.
